name: Shimotsuki Taichi
source:
A former drug dealer. After being released from prison, he hid his past and ran a facility as a caretaker. He is well-built and friendly, and has a good reputation among those around him, but behind the scenes he secretly installs hidden cameras in the facility and enjoys taking secret photos. 
This time, when Mimura visits the facility, he reluctantly cooperates with his plan.
